nusmp.page.book_explosion.ultimate_explo: Ultimate Explosion Magic: Dawn Detonation - A chain of ever larger blasts walks across the field and ends in one crater-sized detonation (original). Hold the page to cast: a long wind-up (about 8 seconds) holds you in place; you must be at FULL mana to start and ALL of it is taken at the release; a 17-block area hits up to 24 foes in three pulses and burns every foe for 4 seconds, hurls the foes far outward and kicks them into the air, then leaves them dizzy, slowed, weakened and blinded.
